message: 恋する気持ちは３拍子

name: Ria
message: 「...And there. What do you think, Sis...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Mastering it completely in just a few days--what a terrifying child! That's my little sister for you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Make up your mind if you're praising me or putting me down\s02」

name: Helena
message: 「With this, you won't embarrass yourself anymore, at least」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪ Thanks for teaching me, Sis」

name: Helena
message: 「Though, the only thing left is... whether it goes well during the real thing」

name: Ria
message: 「It's already tomorrow, huh... the dance workshop」

name: Helena
message: 「Huh? What are you talking about? You're going to teach Synn-chan, aren't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh」

name: Helena
message: 「Whether you can dance well in front of Synn-chan is the biggest issue, right...」

name: Ria
message: 「Wh--!? H-How did it come to that!」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, didn't you want to look cool in front of Synn-chan?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's not like that\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm~~」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It really isn't!\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「Your face is bright red. You won't be able to dance properly like that, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, he's probably still around. Go teach him properly\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez! I told you I'll be fine!!」
All right, the program for tomorrow's workshop is all set.
Now, as Student Council President, it'd be great if I could pull off a dance worthy of being an example, though......

name: Synn
message: 「In the end, Ria-senpai never taught me......」
Wait, I'm trying to rely on Ria-senpai again!
I have to do my best on my own.
Still......

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Want to dance with me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Groooowl. Groooowl」

name: Synn
message: 「...No helping it, I'll do my best on my own. Un, deux, trois--」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you... see that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Loud and clear...」
Sigh... Of all people, Ria-senpai had to see me look so uncool.

name: Ria
message: 「You were... practicing dancing」

name: Ria
message: 「Inhaaaale, exhaaaale」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Want to head out to the courtyard for a bit?」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, over here, over here!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Heeere, give me your hand\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「We don't have music, but we can still keep the rhythm, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could that mean--」

name: Ria
message: 「Yup♪ Ria-senpai's dance workshop~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Though the big day is already tomorrow\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「No... it's fine. Really, I should be able to pull it off properly without Ria-senpai having to teach me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...?」

name: Synn
message: 「In the end, I've just been relying on Ria-senpai the whole time, I...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm happy to be relied on, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「But that's only because I'm your junior... right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's dance, Synn-kun」
I find myself drawn into that outstretched hand.
I wrap my fingers over the back of her hand, enveloping it.

name: Ria
message: 「I'll take the lead, so do your best to step forward」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Ria
message: 「We're turning to the right」
My arm is pulled in, and I fall into step with Ria-senpai's rhythm.

name: Ria
message: 「That's it. Keep your back straight, on your toes--」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Now you're puffing your chest out too much\s04　Calm down. Come on, bring your feet together」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
Ria-senpai suddenly closes the distance between us.

name: Ria
message: 「Right now is when you take a step back. Like they say, if pushing doesn't work, try pulling♪」
Ria-senpai's soft, warm hand.

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, no good. Now we're turning left next」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh--」
Our feet get tangled and we lose our balance. In a panic, I catch Ria-senpai around the waist.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry!」
We managed to avoid falling over, though the dance came to a halt.

name: Synn
message: 「At this rate, it's not much of a practice, is it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if I'm about to fall, Synn-kun will catch me nice and safe」

name: Ria
message: 「Wouldn't it make you happy to have me rely on you, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Ria
message: 「Is it because I'm your senior after all?」

name: Ria
message: 「I want to rely on you because you're you, Synn-kun, and I want you to rely on me for the exact same reason」

name: Ria
message: 「If you wouldn't rely on me unless I were your upperclassman... that would just be sad」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel the exact same way. If I weren't your underclassman, you wouldn't pay any attention to me, Ria-senpai」
Ria-senpai rhythmically bobs her hips up and down, and I match her steps as if drawn in by her lead.

name: Ria
message: 「To tell you the truth... I couldn't dance at all before」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「But, you know. I worked really hard because I wanted you to rely on me, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... You really are amazing, Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「What's amazing is that you're the one who got me able to dance. If you hadn't been there, I wouldn't have been able to dance at all, you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Like this, you know. When I'm with you, Synn-kun, I... feel like I can do anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai...」
There are plenty of things I was only able to do because Ria-senpai was there for me, too.
Making KiraFes a success.
Getting good grades on my tests even while distracted by Student Council duties.
Dealing with the Demon Lord.
And my desire to make this year's Holy Night Festival a success.
As long as Ria-senpai is with me, I can overcome any obstacle.
Ria-senpai steps forward, closing the distance between our faces all at once.

name: Ria
message: 「Didn't I tell you earlier? You're supposed to take a step back right there」
We gently bump our foreheads together.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry. I just... really wanted to be with you, Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... I wanted to dance with you like this too, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「We can't really call this dancing anymore, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Why not?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you're so close to me, Ria-senpai」
We're close enough to feel each other's breath.
The tips of our noses brush together, and a deep affection swells within me.
Even though I want to kiss those lips, our shyness gets mixed in, making us tease each other instead.

name: Ria
message: 「No fair, Synn-kun... Something like this has to come from the guy...」

name: Synn
message: 「You always do that, treating me like a guy only when it's convenient for you」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, I am a girl, after all... I might be your senior, Synn-kun, but I still want to be seen as a girl」

name: Synn
message: 「I've always... looked at you as a girl, Ria―senpai. You're so kind, and so warm―」

name: Synn
message: 「I love you, Ria-senpai」
Holding her trembling shoulders, I bring my lips closer to hers.
Contrary to her words, all strength drains from Senpai's body, leaving everything to me.
Those desperate words were the last bit of resistance put up by her title as my senior.

name: Ria
message: 「Mm... mmph... *gasp*. Haaa...」
The moment our lips touch, my mind goes completely blank, and we part before I even have time to savor the sensation.

name: Ria
message: 「Geez... kissing me out of nowhere isn't fair...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm a guy too, you know...」

name: Ria
message: 「I... haven't even given you my answer yet」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't seem like you hated it, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「You shouldn't be so forceful. If you do that, I'm just going to fall for you even harder...」

name: Synn
message: 「It was my first time, so I didn't really know what to do...」

name: Ria
message: 「It was my first time too, you know. So be gentle with me... mmh」
This time, Ria-senpai presses her lips against mine.

name: Ria
message: 「Mmph, mm, *chu*... *chu*... nfuu...」
Ria-senpai repeatedly taps her soft lips against my mouth.

name: Ria
message: 「Mm... *chu*, *chu*... mm, mph, fuuu...」
An awkward, hesitant kiss. Watching her like this, my tension gradually melts away.
It really is her first time, and she's trying so desperately.
She's always the one taking the lead, yet she's completely hopeless when it comes to romance.

name: Ria
message: 「Mmh... mmph, *chuu*... *slurp*」
Just as I let my guard down, something wet brushes against my lips.
And then, it parts my lips and begins to slip inside.

name: Ria
message: 「Mmh... nn, nchuu... nnh, pururu, rurero... nn, nmuu...」
Ria-senpai is moving freely inside my mouth.
Filled with a warm, pleasant sensation, I could do nothing but surrender myself to the act.

name: Ria
message: 「Nn... puh, haa...」

name: Ria
message: 「H-How was that...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn...-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A grown-up kiss...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「...Ufufu\s04 Well, I am the older one here, after all♪」
